<setup_md>
# Ægis KCP Package — Setup Guide for {domain}

Thank you for your Ægis AI-Readiness Package. This guide explains what's included and how to deploy each file.

---

## What's in this package

| File | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `knowledge.yaml` | Root manifest — identity + links to sub-files |
| `knowledge/products.yaml` | Products & services detail |
| `knowledge/people.yaml` | Key people & leadership |
| `knowledge/technology.yaml` | Tech stack, integrations, AI context |
| `knowledge/customers.yaml` | Target customer segments & model |
| `knowledge/compliance.yaml` | Certifications, security, regulatory context |
| `llms.txt` | Plain-text summary following the llms.txt standard — serve at `{url}/llms.txt` |
| `CLAUDE.md` | Context file for Claude (Anthropic), Cursor, and compatible AI coding tools |
| `AGENTS.md` | Context file for AI agents — start agent sessions with this file |
| `SETUP.md` | This file |

---

## Deployment steps

### 1. `llms.txt` — Serve publicly

Upload `llms.txt` to your web server so it's accessible at:

```
{url}/llms.txt
```

This follows the emerging [llms.txt standard](https://llmstxt.org/) and makes your company's context discoverable by AI tools automatically.

### 2. `CLAUDE.md` — Claude / Cursor integration

Place `CLAUDE.md` in one of these locations:

- **Project root**: `/path/to/your/project/CLAUDE.md`
- **Claude global**: `~/.claude/CLAUDE.md` (applies to all projects)
- **Cursor**: `.cursor/rules/context.md` (adjust path per Cursor docs)

Claude Code and Cursor will automatically load this file as project context.

### 3. `AGENTS.md` — Agent sessions

Provide `AGENTS.md` to your AI agent at session start:
- As a system prompt or user message attachment
- Via an MCP memory tool
- Or paste the contents into the first message of each agent session

### 4. `knowledge/` — Structured data hierarchy

Use the `knowledge/` files in pipelines, RAG systems, or internal tools:
- `knowledge.yaml` — root manifest with identity and imports
- Sub-files are self-contained and can be loaded individually

Serve `knowledge.yaml` with [kcp-mcp](https://ægis.no) to make your full knowledge graph available to AI agents via MCP.

---

## Questions?

Reply to the delivery email or write to **selina@exoreaction.com**.

*Package generated {date} · Ægis by eXOReaction*
</setup_md>
